cohort: 116 patients diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) at the First Hospital of Hebei Medical University from February 2020 to December 2021
finding: Systematic pregnancy management in patients with GDM resulted in lower blood glucose levels, improved lipid metabolism, and shorter labor durations compared to routine nursing.
mod_finding: The rate of natural delivery was higher in the intervention group (systematic pregnancy management) compared to the control group (routine nursing), while the rate of cesarean section was lower.
